scope: Metadata-only diagnosis of the Mistral-regex warning in the pinned local Qwen tokenizer; no weights or inference.
diagnosis: The generic local-tokenizer check treats config.json as Mistral-related when transformers_version is absent. The stored model_type is qwen3_5_text. Its original regex equals the installed Qwen3.5 regex and the default loader leaves it unchanged.
action: Keep the pinned Qwen tokenizer unchanged; do not apply the unrelated Mistral regex patch.
limitations: Eight tokenization samples do not prove general model accuracy.
This verifies the pinned local metadata used for parity checks; server artifacts retain their existing separate attestation.
